edges.reason: Gold blocks are placed inside the desert temple interior on the floor at (7-9, 1, 10-11). Player must locate and enter the temple to see them.
Stone brick stairs are structural elements inside the desert temple along the east wall. Player must enter the temple to find them.
The water pool is located in the temple floor at (6-7, -1, 6-8). Player must find and enter the temple to access the water source.
The magenta wool materials are locked behind an iron door at (-2, 1-2, 9) that requires a lever to open. Player must craft and place the lever to enter.
The chest containing light_gray_wool for carpet crafting is at the top of the stone brick stairs at (11, 4, 9). Player must find and climb the stairs to reach it.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Temple entrance is at spawn-relative (8, 2, 4). Max_distance=5 forces actual navigation since the player spawns ~9.2 blocks away (sqrt(64+4+16)). Facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the structure, confirming visual identification.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Gold blocks are inside the temple at (7-9, 1, 10-11). Max_distance=4 requires the player to have entered the temple and navigated to the back area where gold is placed on the floor. Distance from spawn to target is ~12.8 blocks, so player must move significantly.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Stone brick stairs are along the temple's east interior wall at (11, 1-3, 6-8). Max_distance=4 requires being inside the temple near the stairs. Distance from spawn to target is ~13.2 blocks.

Uses inventory_has because picking up water with an empty bucket converts it into a water_bucket item in the player's inventory. The player starts with an empty bucket and the water pool is inside the temple at (6-7, -1, 6-8). This transformation is unambiguous and cleanly verifiable.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because white stained glass does NOT drop as an item when mined without Silk Touch enchantment (player only has regular iron pickaxe). Instead of checking inventory (impossible), we verify all 3 glass blocks at (4, 3, 7-9) have been destroyed. Box [2,2,5] to [6,4,11] encompasses all positions: x=4 in [2,6], y=3 in [2,4], z=7-9 in [5,11].

Uses inventory_has because crafting light_gray_carpet (2 light_gray_wool placed horizontally in crafting grid) produces 3 light_gray_carpet in the player's inventory. Materials come from the chest at the top of the stone brick stairs. Player does not start with this item.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block', object='lever') because the player must craft the lever AND place it adjacent to the iron door to open the gated room. Checking for a placed lever block resolves the timing conflict where inventory_has would fail after placement. Box [-4,1,7] to [0,3,11] covers the wall area around the iron door at (-2, 1-2, 9) where the lever would logically be placed.

Uses inventory_has because crafting magenta_wool (1 white_wool + 1 magenta_dye in crafting grid) produces 1 magenta_wool in the player's inventory. Materials are in a chest inside the gated room, accessible only after the lever opens the iron door. Player does not start with this item.

scene_description: A desert temple structure with water-filled lower chamber, stone brick stairs with chest at top, gold blocks on the back wall floor, white stained glass windows on west wall, and a separate gated room sealed by an iron door requiring a lever. Crafting stations and material chests support all 8 tasks with physically real dependencies. The temple is located northeast of spawn (~8 blocks away), with an outside crafting area to the west of spawn and a gated room further west.
task_text: Explore the desert temple complex: find the temple and enter it, locate gold blocks and stone brick stairs inside, pick up water from the temple's floor pool with your bucket, mine the white stained glass windows, climb the stairs to find carpet materials and craft light gray carpet, craft a lever and place it to open the sealed room, then craft magenta wool from materials inside.
design_notes: Final clean command list (46 commands). Layout: Player spawns at (0,0,0). Desert temple at (4-12, 0-6, 4-12) with south-facing entrance at (8, 1-3, 4). Gold blocks at (7-9, 1, 10-11) on temple back floor. Stone brick stairs ascending east wall (11, 1-4, 6-9) with support blocks and chest at top (11, 4, 9). White stained glass on west wall (4, 3, 7-9). Water pool in temple floor (6-7, -1, 6-8). Outside crafting table at (-3, 1, 5) with lever materials chest at (-3, 1, 4). Gated room (-7 to -2, 0-4, 7-12) with iron door at (-2, 1-2, 9). Air blocks explicitly placed at (-1, 1-2, 9) to ensure clear approach to door. Interior crafting table at (-5, 1, 10) with magenta materials chest at (-5, 1, 9). Player given bucket and iron pickaxe. Command order ensures later setblock commands properly override hollow fills.
